cohort: Adolescents born early preterm (n = 68), moderately-late preterm (n = 128), and full-term (n = 78)
finding: Early preterm and moderately-late preterm adolescents reported increased pain sensitivity compared to full-term adolescents.
mod_finding: For early preterm adolescents, C-section was not associated with pain sensitivity in adolescence.
